policy: Each exception names one advisory on one exact locked package version with no patched release. Any other moderate+ advisory, a changed version, an expired review date or a stale entry fails npm run check:dependencies.

exceptions.reachability: Runtime. Deep Agents glob/grep filtering passes patterns to micromatch; a deeply nested pattern can exhaust the stack of the process evaluating it.
exceptions.reason: Every published braces version is affected and npm's only remediation downgrades deepagents to 0.0.2, which removes the runtime.

exceptions.reachability: Test fixtures generate ephemeral TLS certificates; promptfoo uses it only for Java keystore loading. Rocky never verifies RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signatures with node-forge.
exceptions.reason: Every published node-forge version is affected and npm's only remediation downgrades promptfoo to 0.116.7.
